critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx has grown to 1023 lines. Splitting into per-tab components (PrintersTab, DatabaseTab, SurveyDialog, RecapTab, SettingsTab, UsersTab, BranchesTab, ServicesTab, CountersTab, DashboardTab) is now urgent for maintainability.
PUT /api/branches/{id} returns only {ok:true}; consider returning the updated document (like update_user does) for consistency and to avoid a re-fetch on the client.
server.py primary_color still has no hex format validation on SettingsInput (carryover from iter3).
db_restore has no size limit / auth-rate protection; a malicious admin could DoS via huge JSON. Acceptable for admin-only, but consider validating collection size / bson-safe insertion.
Survey photo is stored as base64 data URL inline on ticket doc; large photos may bloat tickets. Consider capping payload size on backend (currently client-side compress only).
kiosk receipt uses inline HTML print styling; @media print rules in index.css should be re-audited to ensure only #print-area prints (verified only visually).
